name: Proper Progress
organisation: Proper Job Theatre Company, with KLTV and Thread Republic
status: Live - grant-funded project (status not stated in the pathways document)
whoFor: Adults who are not working or looking for work because of barriers such as poor physical or mental health, isolation, caring responsibilities, low confidence, disability or language barriers.
eligibility: Economically inactive adult (not working and not looking for work)

activities.name: Personalised information, advice and guidance
activities.summary: Outreach, assessment, goal setting, an individual learning plan and one-to-one progression support.

activities.name: Creative Learning with Proper Job
activities.summary: Creative drama, storytelling, role play and group activities to build confidence, communication, teamwork, resilience and wellbeing.

activities.name: Digital Content Creation with KLTV
activities.summary: Making digital content and short films to develop communication, digital and presentation skills.

activities.name: Sustainability, Upcycling and Personal Presentation with Thread Republic
activities.summary: Practical upcycling and personal presentation skills to build confidence and self-esteem.

workExperience: Prepares people for volunteering, learning and work; no placement stated
